mapper.sql: FROM PEACH_MEMBER_ROLE_BINDING B INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT_MEMBER M ON M.ID = B.MEMBER_REF_ID AND M.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND M.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND M.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_USER U ON U.ID = M.USER_REF_ID AND U.IS_DELETE = 0 AND U.STATUS IN ('1', 'ENABLE') INNER JOIN PEACH_TENANT T ON T.ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND T.STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND T.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_APPLICATION A ON A.ID = B.APP_REF_ID AND A.TENANT_ID = T.TENANT_ID AND A.IS_OPEN = 1 AND A.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE R ON R.ID = B.ROLE_REF_ID AND R.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND R.APP_REF_ID = B.APP_REF_ID AND R.ROLE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND R.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_ROLE_PERMISSION RP ON RP.ROLE_REF_ID = R.ID AND RP.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID AND RP.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND RP.IS_DELETE = 0 INNER JOIN PEACH_PERMISSION_DEFINITION P ON P.ID = RP.PERMISSION_REF_ID AND P.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND P.IS_DELETE = 0 AND (P.APP_REF_ID IS NULL OR P.APP_REF_ID = B.APP_REF_ID) AND ((P.OWNER_TYPE = 'SYSTEM' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID IS NULL) OR (P.OWNER_TYPE = 'TENANT' AND P.TENANT_REF_ID = B.TENANT_REF_ID))
